ui.description2: healthcare environments. Please check the detailed images.

list.title: Forklift Pallet Loading and Transport in Logistics Warehouse
list.hazard: Forklift tip-over during sharp turns, pedestrian collision due to obstructed view
list.measure: Observe 10km/h speed limit, assign spotters, and verify mast tilting for stability

list.title: Patient Mobility Assistance and Medical Waste Handling in Wards
list.hazard: Falls during patient transfer, infection from needlestick injuries
list.measure: Verify wheelchair/bed wheel locks, strictly prohibit re-capping used needles

list.title: Mowing and Tree Pruning in Green Zones
list.hazard: Impact from flying debris due to broken blades, shock from overhead power lines
list.measure: Wear mesh face shields, maintain 2m distance from electrical facilities, and restrict access

list.title: Foot Patrol in Vulnerable Areas and Traffic Marshaling
list.hazard: Collision with incoming vehicles, assault/injury from suspicious persons during night patrol
list.measure: Wear high-visibility reflective vests, follow 2-person patrol rule, and carry defensive gear

list.title: Laboratory Reagent Preparation and Analytical Equipment Operation
list.hazard: Toxic gas leakage due to poor hood performance, chemical burns from reagent splashing
list.measure: Perform work within Fume Hoods, complete MSDS training, and wear dedicated PPE

list.title: Underground Parking Lot Deep Cleaning and High-pressure Washing
list.hazard: Collision with uncontrolled vehicles, electric shock from power tools in wet areas
list.measure: Set up traffic cones, use power via GFCI, and wear insulated rubber boots

list.title: Waste Shredder Operation and Inlet Clog Removal
list.hazard: Body parts caught in shredder inlet, crushing due to unexpected startup by others
list.measure: Shut off main power and implement LOTO, use dedicated hand tools instead of hands

list.title: Exterior Glass Cleaning and Boatswain's Chair Operation
list.hazard: Falls due to rope wear or failure, impact on pedestrians from falling tools
list.measure: Install separate vertical lifelines, assign ground controllers, and set up boundaries

list.title: Food Pre-processing and Large Cauldron Cooking in Mass Catering
list.hazard: Slipping and falls due to wet floors, burns from hot oil or steam contact
list.measure: Wear certified non-slip kitchen shoes, equip Class K fire extinguishers, and remove moisture

list.title: Server Rack Installation and Tray Laying in Data Centers
list.hazard: Crushing from rack inertia during moving, falls from ladders during high work
list.measure: Perform work in teams of 3, prohibit standing on ladder top-cap, and assign ground support
